mechanism_builds.causal_path: skin_hydration ↑ & stratum_corneum_thickness ↓ → electrode_skin_impedance ↓ → eda_phasic_amplitude ↑ (less attenuation) → eda_signal_to_noise_ratio ↑ → stress_detection_uncertainty ↓
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Higher skin hydration and thinner stratum corneum reduce impedance, increase EDA SNR, and decrease subject-level stress detection uncertainty.
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Mechanism can be tested by controlled hydration manipulation (occlusion vs. drying) and measuring impedance/EDA SNR changes; include skin conductance level (SCL) as covariate.

mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Lower baseline HRV (RMSSD, HF power) predicts higher subject-level stress detection uncertainty due to compressed physiological dynamic range.
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Use latent profile analysis to define autonomic phenotypes; test interaction between phenotype and stressor intensity on uncertainty.

mechanism_builds.causal_path: vo2_max ↑ → parasympathetic_tone ↑ → stress_delta_hr ↓ (blunted) & stress_delta_hrv ↑ (exaggerated withdrawal) → feature_distribution_shift_vs_low_fitness → mixed_population_classifier_misestimation → prediction_interval_width ↑ for_high_fitness

mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Include fitness as explicit feature or use mixture-of-experts; test if fitness-specific models reduce uncertainty.

mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Compare static vs. online-updating models; use sliding window calibration to track uncertainty dynamics.
